triggers.name: new_lead
triggers.title: New lead
triggers.help: This trigger consumes webhooks and execute recipe actions when webhooks are received. The Workato URL to send webhooks to is https://webhooks.trial.workato.com/webhooks/notify/unbounce?uuid=new-lead-{{authUser.webhookId}}

input.name: page_id
input.label: Page ID
input.hint: Found at the end of respective page's URL

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Fetch leads created after specified time. Leave blank to fetch leads created since one hour. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more
